name: Environment Production
author: PolyKit
description: Builds deterministic server-owned environment meshes from explicit terrain and river specifications.

zh-CN.name: 环境制作
zh-CN.description: 根据明确的地形和河流规范生成确定性的服务端环境网格。

en-US.name: Environment Production
en-US.description: Builds deterministic server-owned environment meshes from explicit terrain and river specifications.

nodes.name: Terrain Mesh
nodes.description: Compiles seeded regions, edge falloff, rivers, and an optional water plane into a GLB terrain mesh.

params_schema.label: Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Grid resolution per side. Higher values add geometry and build time.

params_schema.label: Include Water
params_schema.tooltip: Add a separate water plane at the declared seaLevel.

params_schema.label: Water Thickness
params_schema.tooltip: Thickness of the exported water slab.

nodes.name: Procedural City Blockout
nodes.description: Builds a deterministic flat city blockout with roads, setbacks, and varied building masses.

params_schema.label: Block Rows
params_schema.tooltip: Number of city blocks along the depth axis.

params_schema.label: Block Columns
params_schema.tooltip: Number of city blocks along the width axis.

params_schema.label: Building Density
params_schema.tooltip: Chance that each lot receives a building mass.

params_schema.label: Include Ground
params_schema.tooltip: Add a single ground slab beneath the road grid.

nodes.name: Vegetation Scatter
nodes.description: Builds deterministic low-poly vegetation and rock instances that can be composed over a terrain mesh.

params_schema.label: Instance Count
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum number of placed vegetation or rock instances.

params_schema.label: Minimum Distance
params_schema.tooltip: Minimum horizontal separation between instance origins.

params_schema.label: Include Ground
params_schema.tooltip: Add a thin reference ground slab; leave off when composing over terrain-mesh.
